imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product imagery. Commercial recommendations use accurate category text links only.

searchConsole.signal: Eight homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 3.125 and no query rows
searchConsole.decision: The queryless sample is too small to support a Data-led page. Today's evergreen portfolio strengthens crawl paths through established eye-care, travel and home-emergency clusters while answering three distinct reader needs.
searchConsole.ignored: Homepage-only impressions, one aggregate average position and the absence of query rows were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for a keyword variation or topical pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow text recommendations appear only on the carry-on luggage guide: two-wheel roller, four-wheel spinner and clamshell travel-backpack categories. The contact-lens and frozen-pipe pages remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy frozen-pipe prevention and response record that maps vulnerable lines, shutoff access, cold-weather controls, lost-flow triage, safe thaw limits, burst response and the plumber/insurer handoff.
authority.cluster: Household water-emergency authority, with reciprocal contextual links from the main-shutoff, power-outage and flood-cleanup guides; the eye-care and travel clusters also gain reciprocal paths.
authority.opportunity: American Red Cross preparedness education and state utility consumer-education teams logged as qualified accuracy-and-education opportunities; no outreach sent.

diversity: The portfolio answers three unrelated questions in two departments: how to handle a prescribed medical device safely, which carry-on architecture fits a specific itinerary, and how to prevent or triage a frozen water line. The luggage guide serves purchase intent, the frozen-pipe record expands household-emergency authority, and the contact-lens system explores a neglected grooming-health handoff; none is driven by the weak Search Console sample.
